title: Develop evidence-bound NSFC proposal figures
description: Prepare programme- and section-specific prompts for visually substantive biomedical proposal illustrations, bind scientific relations to reviewed evidence, separate generated visual references from observed data, require object-editable reconstruction, and block insertion until final-size scientific, typography, layer-order, alignment, text-boundary, element-weight and spatial-balance review passes without errors.
intents: 基金申请书科学假说图
questions: How should a rationale, scientific hypothesis, research workflow, technical route, preliminary foundation or achievement-lineage figure be designed and visually reviewed for an NSFC proposal?
preconditions: The exact programme type, proposal section, core message, surrounding claims, evidence records, intended panels, source attributions and final output dimensions are supplied.
Literature used in a rationale or mechanism illustration has completed citation-identity verification and full-text or original-source review.
Observed preliminary panels are bound to real source artifacts and a deterministic or source-preserving renderer.
assumptions: Generated imagery is used only as a non-evidentiary visual reference or separable biological asset; it never substitutes for observed data.

quality_gates.description: The figure role, surrounding argument, allowed conclusion and forbidden implications are explicit.
Scientifically meaningful tissue, cellular, subcellular, molecular, model or observed-data elements carry the visual narrative; a text-box flowchart is insufficient.
Font families, size levels and text colours remain restrained and consistent; declared z-order prevents background art, biological assets or connectors from covering labels, legends or data.

Logically corresponding elements occupy matched positions, text stays inside its intended bounds without covering scientific visuals, and meaningful elements carry labels unless an explicit exception is justified.
Every visual element has a distinct scientific contribution and declared narrative weight; redundant decoration is removed and information density plus whitespace are balanced across the composition.
The final figure remains within the document text area and occupies an explicitly centered, placeholder-free paragraph with no leading spaces, tabs or indentation offsets.
Every factual node and evidentiary connector is linked to a reviewed literature, database or preliminary-data record.
Labels, citations, relations, legends and deterministic data panels are rebuilt as editable objects rather than retained as generated pseudo-text or a full-page screenshot.
The rendered figure is reviewed at final insertion size and cannot pass while any scientific-semantic or layout error remains.

limitations: The module produces a reviewed prompt and reconstruction contract. Codex must still run the declared image-generation and editable-reconstruction steps, inspect every rendered iteration, and record the accepted artifact.

dependencies.name: python
dependencies.purpose: Validate proposal-figure semantics and prepare deterministic generation and reconstruction prompts.
